$comment: Moonshine-base ASR (moonshine-ai/moonshine-base). Encoder-decoder transformer on raw 16kHz PCM; no mel frontend. Padded dims are the accelerator-side obligations from hw_notes; the CPU reference runs the unpadded HF shapes.
hw_notes: 64-ALU floor: hidden 416 -> pad to 448 (zero lanes 416..447 on every matmul N/K); intermediate 1664 is already 26*64.
head_dim 52 (HF pads to 56 for SDPA) -> pad to 64 on the accelerator; scaling stays 52**-0.5 (HF uses the unpadded head_dim).

RoPE: partial rotary, rotary_dim = int(52*0.62) = 32 on the first 32 lanes, interleaved (GPT-J) pairs, remaining 20 lanes pass through. Needs a custom cos/sin table for the padded 64-lane head; d64_pbi assumes full-head half-split so use hf_core or a bespoke table.
Decoder gated MLP: fc1 emits 2*1664 with x = first half, gate = second half; out = silu(gate) * x (note order: gate is the SECOND chunk).

Conv stem on raw PCM: conv1 k=127 s=64 no bias -> tanh -> GroupNorm(1 group) -> conv2 k=7 s=3 -> gelu -> conv3 k=3 s=2 -> gelu. Frames = ((N-127)//64+1 - 7)//3+1 ... ; map as im2col matmuls (ACT pattern).
Compile-then-execute: audio length and decode length are runtime-dependent -> fix max_audio_seconds (encoder frames = ~T*16000/384) and max_length 194 decode steps; run all steps and mask after EOS.
Cross-attention K/V computed once from encoder output; cache them in DRAM (not per-step recompute).
Decoder self-attn K/V cache grows to 194 rows max; over-allocate at compile time.

dram_layout.$comment: 61.5M params bf16 = 123MB + tied proj_out; comfortably under tensor_base. Sizing to be re-done by scripts/new_model.py on a box with user_dma_core.
